questions.prompt: A system only logs air pressure and emails warnings. It is primarily a:
Explain how feedback is used by an automatic greenhouse fan.
questions.model_answer: A temperature sensor repeatedly measures the greenhouse temperature. The controller compares the reading with a target. It turns the fan on or off through an actuator and uses later sensor readings to check and adjust its decision.
questions.grading_criterion:
1: Describe repeated sensing of temperature.
1: Describe comparison with a target or threshold.
1: Describe action and adjustment based on subsequent readings.
questions.student_guidance:
Describe the measurement.
Describe the decision rule.
Describe what happens after action is taken.

questions.prompt: Explain why a smart thermostat is considered an embedded system and give one possible disadvantage.
questions.model_answer: It is a computer integrated into a thermostat to perform a specific temperature-control function. A possible disadvantage is limited upgradeability or specialised repair needs.
questions.grading_criterion:
1: Explain that computing is built into a larger device.
1: Identify its dedicated control task.
1: Give a plausible limitation of an embedded system.
questions.student_guidance:
Consider where the computer is located.
Name the primary task.
Think about upgrades or repairs.
